# AgentMason Employee Handbook

## Company Overview

AgentMason is an enterprise-grade AI agent framework company founded in 2023. We build intelligent automation solutions for enterprise clients.

## Paid Time Off (PTO) Policy

### Annual PTO Allocation

All full-time employees receive **20 days of paid time off per year**.

This includes:
- Vacation days: 15 days
- Personal days: 5 days

Part-time employees receive PTO on a pro-rata basis.

### Accrual and Use

- PTO accrues monthly (1.67 days per month for full-time employees)
- Employees must submit PTO requests at least 2 weeks in advance
- PTO can be carried over to the next year, up to a maximum of 10 days
- Unused PTO beyond the carryover limit is forfeited

### Exceptions

- Medical leave beyond PTO is covered by our short-term disability program
- Parental leave follows our separate parental leave policy
- Company holidays (10 days per year) are in addition to PTO

## Health Insurance

### Coverage

All full-time employees are eligible for:
- Medical insurance (70% employer-paid, 30% employee-paid)
- Dental insurance (100% employer-paid)
- Vision insurance (100% employer-paid)
- Life insurance (1x annual salary, employer-paid)

### Effective Date

Coverage begins on the first day of employment.

## Work-From-Home Policy

Remote work is permitted:
- 2 days per week from home (flexible schedule)
- Core hours: 10 AM to 3 PM in your local timezone
- All equipment and technology needs are company-provided

## Professional Development

### Training Budget

Each employee receives an annual professional development budget of $2,000.

### Conference Attendance

Company will cover:
- Registration fees for approved conferences
- Travel and accommodation expenses
- Up to 5 business days per year for conference attendance

## Code of Conduct

All employees must:
- Treat colleagues with respect and dignity
- Follow our security policies
- Report any violations to HR
- Maintain confidentiality of company information

## Termination and Severance

### At-Will Employment

Employment is at-will and can be terminated by either party with written notice.

### Severance

- Employees with 1-2 years tenure: 1 week severance per year of service
- Employees with 2+ years tenure: 2 weeks severance per year of service
- Severance is contingent on signing a release agreement

## Questions?

Contact Human Resources at hr@agentmason.com
